title: Revolt of Lyon against the National Convention
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Revolt of Lyon against the National Convention", at revision 1379373387, opens: "The revolt of Lyon against the National Convention was a counter-revolutionary movement in the city of Lyon during the time of the French Revolution. It was a revolt of moderates against the more radical National Convention, the third government during the French Revolution. It broke out in June 1793 and was put down in October of the same year, after government forces had besieged the city." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q16855053, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "counter-revolutionary movement in 1793". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
